name: The Adventuring Party
description: A band of adventurers gathers at the tavern — each a different race, wielding a different weapon. Work out who's who.
clues: Either Lyra goes with Viper or Thorne goes with Raven.

Fenwick, Lyra, and Thorne go with Ranger, Wizard, and Toad, in some order.
Either Thorne goes with Viper, or Ranger goes with Wolf — but not both.
